text.p: Ecolab Inc, which earlier reported higher third-quarter earnings, said Tuesday it expected a record year in 1996.

"With the current strong momentum in our business, we expect 1996 to be another record year for Ecolab, one in which we are likely to meet our longstanding financial objectives for earnings growth, return on equity and balance-sheet quality," said Allan Schuman, president and chief executive.
The maker of cleaning and sanitizing products reported its earnings rose to $35.5 million, or $0.55 a share, in the third quarter from $29.9 million, or $0.46, in the corresponding period of 1995.
Sales rose 12 percent to a record $392 million. All of the company's global operations performed well, it said.

At its U.S. operation, the core Institutional and Food & Beverage businesses showed good sales growth, bolstered by double-digit increases in Pest Elimination and Textile Care, Ecolab said. Its international businesses posted good sales and profit growth, led by results in Latin America, it added.
